향을 유발하는 성분을 통칭해 향료로 표기하기에 실체를 정확히 알 수 없다. 두통, 현기증, 발진, 색소침착, 기관지 자극을 유발한다고 알려져 있다.
파라벤과 함께 많이 사용되는 방부제로 피부 자극을 유발하며 체내 흡수시 마취작용을 하는 것으로 알려져 있다.

reviewList.additionText: I recommend washing this off in the shower. If you’re worried about the scrub clogging up your drain then wipe as much as you can off with a wet wipe prior to rinsing it off.
reviewList.badText:
I don’t recommend this to anyone whose skin’s easily agitated or overly sensitive especially to things that are potentially abrasive. This is no gentle mask. It scratches and to sensitive skin it can feel like the equivalent of shards cutting at skin. It hurts when given a lot of pressure and might end up doing your skin more harm than good. 

The mask is formulated with fragrance and the scent is akin to very strong floral perfume. I’m not fond of it and hope I’M FROM considers reformulating this without it in the future.
reviewList.goodText:
If you’re looking for a wash off mask that’ll exfoliate, brighten, clarify, and moisturize your skin, the Rice Mask delivers results. I always get really baby bottom soft skin that feels extremely smooth and moisturized afterwards. 

It comes with 110g product and can be used when skin feels dull and dehydrated. A single jar lasts for quite a while so the price isn’t so bad if you factor in how many applications you get out of it.

reviewList.goodText:
스크럽한번하고나면 피부가 맨질맨질해져요.!
맨얼굴에는 절대 안되고 설명서에도 나와있지만 물기많이 있는상태에서 살살살 롤링하셔야해요. 
저는 민감한피부인데도 너무 잘쓰고 있어요. 알갱이가 녹는 성분이 아니니 정말 살살문지르고 일주일에 한번내지 두번만 해줍니다.
